1	# Decisions (Acme Notes API S21)
2	
3	- D-t02: Build against API version v1 with base path AX-63003 (error format AX-40567). Relies on facts: product.api_version = v1, api.base_path = AX-63003, api.error_format = AX-40567. Recorded facts were re-checked against repo/api.py and agree.
4	- D-t02 (update, adopt v2): Adopt API version v2 for task t02-choose-api-version. Relies on fact: product.api_version = v2 (source: acme-docs/06_api_style_guide_v2.md). It governs over the earlier D-t02 entry built on product.api_version = v1, because the fact records v1 as superseded and its guide (acme-docs/02_api_style_guide_v1.md) as withdrawn.
5	- D-t13: Reuse the S07 billing cycle ("quarterly, invoiced on day 7", found in history/MEMORY.md and history/logs/researcher.jsonl, Bolt Billing API S07) and the S13 API-key header ("API key in X-Core-Key header", found in history/MEMORY.md and history/logs/planner.jsonl, Acme Notes API S13). Code settings recorded alongside from repo/billing.py: billing.cycle = AX-56904, billing.currency = AX-11674. history/ has no billing currency, so none is reused. Note the S13 header is only a reuse reference: this sprint's t05 decision (JWT for user traffic, X-Api-Key deferred) still governs auth.
6	- D-t05: Use JWT bearer tokens (RS256, Acme identity provider) for all user traffic. Globex's long-lived `X-Api-Key` request is not adopted for user traffic; it is deferred as a separate, scoped service-credential option for back-office scripts, to be reviewed by the security team (no code change now). Relies on facts: security.auth_method = JWT bearer tokens, signed with RS256, issued by the Acme identity provider; customer.requested_auth_method = long-lived API key in X-Api-Key header. The security note governs because it is the security team's standard and long-lived keys weaken it. Also re-read repo/auth.py: auth.token_ttl = AX-65554 (code differs from the earlier recorded AX-81591; code governs), auth.key_header = AX-59960.
7

# CRUD Spec (Acme Notes API S21)

Built against API version v1 (product.api_version = v1), PostgreSQL 16 schema (notes, tags, note_tags), and JWT RS256 bearer auth for user traffic (t05). Values re-read from `repo/` code.

## Code settings

api.base_path: AX-63003
auth.token_ttl: AX-65554
auth.session_cookie: AX-86065
notes.max_length: AX-92475

## Operations

All paths are relative to `api.base_path`. All requests carry `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>`; tokens live for `auth.token_ttl`.

| Operation | Method and path | Notes |
|-----------|-----------------|-------|
| Create | `POST /notes` | Body length limited by `notes.max_length`; returns 201 with the note. |
| Read one | `GET /notes/{id}` | 404 if missing. |
| List | `GET /notes` | Paginated (api.page_size = AX-51173). |
| Update | `PUT /notes/{id}` | Same `notes.max_length` limit. |
| Delete | `DELETE /notes/{id}` | Returns 204. |

Errors use the format AX-40567 (api.error_format).
